papers.title: Real-Time Artificial Intelligence-Based Guidance of Echocardiographic Imaging by Novices: Image Quality and Suitability for Diagnostic Interpretation and Quantitative Analysis
papers.abstract: This study assessed the quality of echocardiographic exams performed by inexperienced users guided by UltraSight AI Guidance software. Results demonstrated that, after minimal training, novices could acquire diagnostic-quality images comparable to those obtained by expert sonographers, suggesting the technology's potential to enhance point-of-care cardiac ultrasound accessibility.

papers.title: Snapshot Artificial Intelligence—Determination of Ejection Fraction From a Single Frame Still Image: A Multi-institutional, Retrospective Model Development and Validation Study
papers.abstract: This study developed and validated an AI model capable of determining ejection fraction from a single-frame still image, demonstrating high accuracy across multiple institutions.

papers.title: AI-Guided Cardiac Imaging: Enhancing Accuracy and Accessibility
papers.abstract: This article reviews the impact of AI-guided cardiac imaging on improving diagnostic accuracy and expanding access to quality imaging in diverse healthcare settings.

papers.title: Real-Time AI Guidance in Cardiac Ultrasound: A Pivotal Study
papers.abstract: A pivotal study demonstrating that real-time AI guidance enables novice users to acquire diagnostic-quality cardiac ultrasound images comparable to those obtained by expert sonographers.

Indications for Use (Describe)

The UltraSight Guidance is intended to assist medical professionals (not including expert sonographers) in acquiring
cardiac ultrasound images. UltraSight Guidance is an accessory to compatible general-purpose diagnostic ultrasound
systems. UltraSight Guidance is indicated for use in two-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography (2D- TTE) for adult
patients, specifically in the acquisition of the following standard views: Parasternal Long-Axis (PLAX), Parasternal Short-
Axis at the Aortic Valve (PSAX-AV), Parasternal Short-Axis at the Mitral Valve (PSAX-MV), Parasternal Short Axis at
the Papillary Muscle (PSAX-PM), Apical 4-Chamber (AP4), Apical 5-Chamber (AP5), Apical 2-Chamber (AP2), Apical
3-Chamber (AP3), Subcostal 4-Chamber (SubC4), and Subcostal Inferior Vena Cava (SC-IVC).
